basic_info.description: On a quiet and clean street in SOMA resides 469 Clementina #6.  It features a newly painted 1 bedroom 1 bath condo with new carpet. It also includes a balcony where you could enjoy a cup of coffee in the morning or a cocktail in the evening. This is a great opportunity for an investor/contractor wanting a quick flip or a homeowner wanting to add your own personal touches to the kitchen and bath. Ideal for those looking for a project with strong investment potential. Building amenities include secure entry, dedicated 1-car parking, storage area, in-building laundry and access to two community rooftop decks, where you can soak in the city views during the day and the city lights at night. You'll love living within walking distance to the vibrant Theater District, SF MOMA, shops, restaurants, Transbay Transit Center, Union Square, Yerba Buena Gardens and easy access to HWY 280/101/80. Don't miss out!
